paragraphs: MyRec.com sells recreation management software, and the page states that it supports over 550 departments across the United States with software for registration, facilities, finances, and more. The platform is offered to the Parks & Recreation industry, and the page describes it as technology that lets organizations manage their back offices. Payment handling is part of what is sold, with an EMV integration for departments that take in-person transactions.

Pricing is presented as one annual fee, with the site build, onboarding and training included in it. The page states that there are no hidden fees, no start-up costs and no long-term contracts. A calculator on the page asks for a department or organization's annual revenue and returns an annual price.
Clients are told they get free training, access to all system features and unlimited user access. Credit card and ACH payments are pointed to a payment processing area of the same site.

quote.text: We make the admin stuff easy, so you can get back to creating fun for your communities.
